series.label: On the early voting list
series.measure: Share of a party's ACTIVE registrants enrolled in the Active Early Voting List
series.denominator: that party's ACTIVE registrants in the unit and build

series.label: Cast an early ballot
series.measure: Share of a party's ballots cast that were cast early
series.denominator: ballots of any type cast by that party in the unit and election
series.build_note: Ballots cast are fixed once an election is over; what moves across builds is which of those voters are still on the roll. Only builds at or after the election are offered.

meta.gap_note: The ballot-type divide is shown for the most recent general (2024-11-05) and the most recent primary (2026-07-21) only.
meta.excluded_elections: Restricted to 2023 onward, matching the window in which the early-voting-list flag is populated. Earlier generals are also unsuitable: the ballot-type coding is not comparable before 2020 (an 'A' code appears only in 2016 and 2018, and 2018 reports an early share of 12% against an actual figure near 75%).
